style: Hand-drawn 2D storybook animation: soft, slightly thick warm-brown pencil outlines, flat colors, no shading on faces, soft cheek blush; painterly backgrounds, dark foreground leaves, softer distant lake. Warm morning sun from the upper left. 16:9.

references.role: only the boy's face, hair, glasses, outfit and proportions
only the look of the two companions
only the gum pack design and label, which never change

boy.block: The boy from @Image1, about eight: dark curly hair, round black glasses, plum beret with two blue feathers, plum shirt, navy shorts, brown boots. Small child hands with exactly five fingers on each hand (four fingers plus one thumb), never four, never six.

companions.block: Agua and Luz from @Image2: a small cyan water-drop spirit with two round eyes, and a tiny golden star spark. Exactly two companions.

axis_rule: Outdoors he always moves from screen left to screen right.

shots.camera: camera trucks right with him through the last leaves
shots.action: He is already walking right, hops a root and stops short at the lake; the pack from @Image3 rests on a mossy stump.
shots.end_frame: he stands left, the stump with the pack right

cut.reason: as his eyes land on the pack

shots.action: He kneels, tears open one small wrapped piece and pops the pink pastille in; the big pack stays closed.

face.eyes: his eyes widen and dart up
face.eyebrows: one eyebrow lifts higher than the other

shots.end_frame: cheeks full, wrapper in his left hand

cut.reason: as he draws a deep breath

shots.action: Boots planted, he blows a bubble in two pulses with a pause between; the second makes it bigger than his torso and bends his knees.

face.eyes: his eyes cross slightly to watch it

shots.end_frame: giant bubble at his lips, arms out for balance

cut.reason: as a ripple opens on the lake behind him

shots.framing: Side tracking shot over the lake
shots.camera: the camera trucks right at his pace
shots.action: Agua rises from the water and Luz drifts down; lily pads rise under his steps, he bounces across, the bubble lifts him and he glides low as lotus buds open where Agua taps.
shots.end_frame: he glides at center, a willow branch ahead at upper right

cut.reason: as the bubble touches the branch

shots.action: The bubble pops at the branch tip and shrinks onto his lips; he hangs a beat, then drops feet first and a drawn splash of rounded white and cyan shapes rises.

cut.reason: on the white splash filling the center

shots.framing: Medium shot in a morning bedroom, his beret on the bedpost
shots.action: He wakes in bed in purple pajamas, looks around, then down at a clearly darker damp patch on the blanket over his lap.

face.cause: it was a dream and the blanket is damp

life: He acts like a real child: whole body in every feeling, both hands on small things. Between actions he breathes, blinks; eyes lead the head; reactions land a half-beat late; hair and feathers settle after he stops.
constraints: No dialogue, speech or voice. No text or watermark. Water and bubble are soft drawn shapes. Same identity and proportions in every shot.
sound: Forest then lake ambience, wrapper tear, rubbery bubble swells, pad slaps, a sharp pop, a soft splash, bedroom tone.
note: Generates 28 s; the 2 s packshot with the editable title is added in the edit (clean still with a slow push from 100% to 103%).
